title: alsine tennesseensis
intro: Alsine tennesseensis, commonly known as Tennessee pearlwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the saxifrage family (Saxifragaceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a possible remedy for various ailments such as fever and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Alsine tennesseensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
